column1: # Mina the Hollower update 1.0.5, SDK 21.4.3, Yacht Club Games' own engine on NVN. Plays on the Mac and the iPhone (README.md).
# Its 114 shaders (110 keys) are in RomFS shaders.pak.yc, a YCD archive that shader_split.py reads (ycd_shaders).
# The update NSP's CNMT names v262144 (nx_extract --contents); its file name has no [v...] tag
# The NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region, where the game maps its memory itself.
# Measured with a 64 GB alias region (DM_ALIAS_SIZE) from boot into the opening on the boat, 7 minutes: nninitStartup's StandardAllocator over 16 GB (main+0x875c5c) maps 1.28 GB;
# the engine's TLSF arenas "Default Mem" and "Render Mem" (4 GB each, cut in patches.py to 1 GB and 256 MB) map 320 MB and 16 MB; twelve 16 MB arenas and one of 64 MB, 0.24 GB of regions.
# the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource
# The regions made after the StandardAllocator's take 1.48 GB with the arena cuts, more than the 256 MB the host's own cap leaves them: the alias region less the 62 MB node area,
# those 1.48 GB and 256 MB for regions made later in play, in 32 MB steps (profile_guess.py stdalloc_room) is 2.56 GB
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 at boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
